definitions.explanation: A period during which farmland is left unplanted, either to rest the soil or because it is not the growing season.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{休耕期|きゅうこうき}だ。
{休耕期|きゅうこうき}に{土|つち}を{休|やす}ませる。
examples.english: Rest the soil during the fallow period.

examples.japanese: {休耕期|きゅうこうき}の{間|あいだ}に{農機具|のうきぐ}の{手入|てい}れをする。
examples.english: During the fallow period, we maintain the farm equipment.

notes:
Formed from {休耕|きゅうこう} (leaving land fallow) + {期|き} (period). Refers to when fields are deliberately left uncultivated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休耕期|きゅうこうき}に{入|はい}る: to enter the fallow period
- {休耕期|きゅうこうき}の{畑|はたけ}: a fallow field

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農閑期|のうかんき}: agricultural off-season — the slack season for farm work in general
- {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}: fallow rice paddy — a field left uncultivated
